recipes.name: Protein sambar (1 bowl)
ingredients: 100 g sambar vegetables (drumstick, brinjal, pumpkin, okra)
1 tsp sambar powder, pinch turmeric and hing
3 g oil, mustard seeds, curry leaves, 1 dried red chilli
steps: Pressure-cook the dal with turmeric for 3 whistles, then mash.
Simmer the vegetables, onion and tomato in tamarind water with sambar powder and salt for 8–10 min.
Add the dal and simmer 5 min.
Temper oil with mustard, hing, curry leaves and red chilli; pour over.
recipes.tip: Make 3 bowls on Sunday (Mon, Wed, Thu). Keeps 3 days in the fridge; freeze Thursday's.

recipes.name: Idli + protein sambar + boiled egg
steps: Steam the idlis 10–12 min.
Boil the egg 9 min, cool and peel.
Serve with hot sambar.
recipes.tip: Coconut chutney adds about 100 kcal per 2 tbsp; tomato or pudina chutney is almost free.

recipes.name: Paneer pesarattu + ginger-tomato chutney
ingredients: 60 g whole green moong, soaked 6–8 h
1 green chilli, 5 g ginger, ½ tsp cumin, salt
40 g paneer, grated, + a little chopped onion
Chutney: 100 g tomato, 5 g ginger, 1 dried red chilli
steps: Grind the soaked moong with chilli, ginger, cumin and salt to a pourable batter.
Spread 2 thin dosas on a hot tawa with 5 g oil.
Sprinkle paneer and onion on top, fold and cook through.
Chutney: sauté tomato, ginger and chilli in 3 g oil, then blend with salt.
recipes.tip: Soak the moong the night before.

recipes.name: Pesarattu + chutney + boiled egg
ingredients: Same pesarattu batter and chutney as above, no paneer
steps: Make 2 pesarattu as above.
Boil the egg, or crack it over the dosa while it cooks (egg pesarattu).

recipes.name: Egg bhurji (2 eggs + 3 whites) + 1 chapati
ingredients: 50 g onion, 50 g tomato, 1 green chilli
Pinch turmeric, ½ tsp chilli powder, coriander leaves
steps: Sauté onion and chilli in oil until soft, add tomato and spices and cook 2 min.
Pour in the whisked eggs and scramble on low heat until just set.
Serve with a hot chapati.
recipes.tip: Keep the yolks from the 3 whites for another day, or skip them.

recipes.name: Moong dal paneer chilla + curd
ingredients: 60 g yellow moong dal, soaked 2–3 h
¼ small onion, pinch cumin and chilli
100 g low-fat curd on the side
steps: Blend the moong with a little water and salt to a pancake batter.
Spread on a hot pan with oil, scatter paneer and onion.
Cook both sides until golden. Serve with curd.
recipes.tip: Handbook p.40.

recipes.name: Oats protein breakfast bowl
ingredients: 100 g Greek yogurt or hung curd
steps: Boil the egg 8–10 min.
Layer yogurt, oats and pomegranate in a bowl.
Serve with the halved egg.
recipes.tip: Handbook p.7. For a warm version, microwave the oats with yogurt for 60–90 s.

recipes.name: Oats & whey power bowl (full scoop) + papaya
recipes.source: Handbook p.8, full scoop of your whey
steps: Simmer oats in milk 4–5 min until thick.
Cool 1 min, then stir in the whey (too hot and it clumps).
Top with cinnamon; papaya on the side.
recipes.tip: Handbook p.8, made with a full scoop. On Sunday this replaces the shake.

recipes.name: High-protein chicken rice bowl
ingredients: 5 g oil, ½ tsp cumin or paprika, salt, pepper
steps: Cook the rice.
Sear the seasoned chicken 5–6 min per side in oil; rest and slice.
Steam or sauté the vegetables 5 min.
Assemble over rice.
recipes.tip: Handbook p.11.

recipes.name: Chapati chicken bowl
steps: Sear and slice the chicken as for the rice bowl.
Sauté the vegetables.
Serve with warm chapatis.
recipes.tip: Handbook p.12.

recipes.name: Tandoori-style grilled chicken + rice
ingredients: 100 g low-fat curd, 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste
1 tsp tandoori masala, ½ tsp turmeric, juice of ½ lemon
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, paste, masala, turmeric, lemon and salt for 30 min or overnight.
Grill, broil or air-fry 6–8 min per side (oven: 220 °C, 20 min).
Rest 2 min; serve with rice and onion salad.
recipes.tip: Handbook p.13. Your reel's version adds 1 tsp soy sauce and garlic powder to the marinade and scores the chicken deeply; pan-fry 6 min a side or air-fry at 195 °C, 8 min a side.

recipes.name: Chicken tikka masala + rice
ingredients: 30 g low-fat curd, 10 g cashews (soaked, blended)
1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, garam masala, chilli, kasuri methi
steps: Sear the chicken cubes 4–5 min; set aside.
Sauté onion and paste, add tomato and spices, cook 8 min.
Stir in curd and cashew paste, add chicken, simmer 8–10 min.
recipes.tip: Handbook p.15. Swap in for any chicken meal.

recipes.name: Chicken keema + rice
ingredients: 1 small onion, 1 tomato, 50 g green peas
1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, chilli, garam masala
steps: Sauté onion golden, add paste, then tomato and spices until thick.
Add mince, break it up, cook 5 min.
Add peas and a splash of water, cover 6–8 min.
recipes.tip: Handbook p.16. Ask the butcher to mince 150 g of the breast.

recipes.name: Air fryer fish tikka + rice
ingredients: 100 g low-fat curd, 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, 1 tsp tikka masala
steps: Marinate fish and vegetables gently for 15–20 min.
Air-fry at 200 °C for 7–8 min, turning once.
Serve with rice and lemon.
recipes.tip: Handbook p.19. Check at 6 min; fish dries fast.

recipes.name: Grilled fish bowl (100 g rice)
steps: Pat fish dry, season with salt, pepper and lemon.
Pan-sear 3–4 min per side.
Serve over rice with the vegetables.
recipes.tip: Handbook p.18, rice cut to 100 g for the rest day.

recipes.name: Palak paneer + rice
ingredients: 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, cumin, garam masala, chilli
steps: Blanch spinach 2 min, cool, blend smooth.
Sauté cumin, onion, paste, tomato and spices until soft.
Add the spinach purée, simmer 3 min, add paneer 2 min.
recipes.tip: Handbook p.26. Regular paneer adds about 200 kcal.

recipes.name: Kadai paneer + rice
ingredients: 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, 1 tsp kadai masala (coarsely crushed coriander, chilli, cumin)
steps: Toss capsicum and onion on high heat 2–3 min; set aside.
Cook paste, tomato and kadai masala until thick.
Add paneer and vegetables, toss 2 min.
recipes.tip: Handbook p.29.

recipes.name: Soya chunks curry + rice
ingredients: 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, chilli, garam masala, coriander powder
steps: Boil soya chunks 5 min, rinse in cold water, squeeze hard.
Cook onion, paste, tomato and spices into a masala.
Add soya and ½ cup water, simmer 8–10 min.
recipes.tip: Handbook p.33.

recipes.name: Soya keema + rice
ingredients: 1 small onion, 1 tomato, 50 g green peas
1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, chilli, garam masala
steps: Soak granules in hot water 5 min; squeeze dry.
Cook the onion-tomato masala, add granules and peas.
Cover and cook 6–8 min until dry.
recipes.tip: Handbook p.35.

recipes.name: Air fryer egg muffin bites
steps: Whisk everything with salt and pepper.
Pour into silicone moulds.
Air-fry at 160 °C for 10–12 min.
recipes.tip: Handbook p.41. Half a batch makes a 190 kcal snack.

recipes.name: Chicken pepper fry (Chettinad-style) + rice + salad
ingredients: 70 g onion, 50 g tomato, curry leaves
1 tsp crushed black pepper, ½ tsp fennel, 1 tsp coriander powder, ½ tsp chilli, ½ tsp ginger-garlic paste
steps: Marinate chicken with turmeric, salt and ginger-garlic for 15 min.
Splutter fennel and curry leaves in oil, sauté onion golden, add tomato and powders.
Add chicken, cook covered 8 min, then uncovered until dry, finishing with the pepper.
recipes.tip: Served with protein sambar on Wednesday.

recipes.name: Andhra fish pulusu + rice
ingredients: 10 g tamarind soaked in 200 ml water
50 g onion, 2 green chillies, 100 g tomato
Turmeric, 1 tsp chilli, 1 tsp coriander powder, pinch fenugreek, curry leaves
steps: Temper mustard, fenugreek and curry leaves in oil; sauté onion and chillies.
Add tomato and powders, then the tamarind water; simmer 8 min.
Slide in the fish and simmer 8–10 min without stirring.
recipes.tip: Tastes better the next day.

recipes.name: Prawn masala (Kerala-style roast) + 1½ chapati
ingredients: 70 g onion, 100 g tomato, curry leaves
1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, ½ tsp pepper, ½ tsp garam masala, turmeric, chilli
steps: Rub prawns with turmeric, chilli and salt for 10 min.
Sauté curry leaves and onion in oil, add paste, tomato and spices until thick.
Add prawns and roast 4–5 min until just curled.
recipes.tip: Overcooked prawns go rubbery; stop at 5 min.

recipes.name: Lean chicken biryani + cucumber raita
ingredients: 50 g curd + ginger-garlic + 1 tsp biryani masala + mint (marinade)
Raita: 100 g curd, 50 g cucumber, roasted cumin
steps: Marinate the chicken 30 min.
Fry onion golden in ghee with whole spices, add chicken and cook 10 min.
Add rice and 120 ml water, cover on the lowest heat 15 min; rest 5 min.
recipes.tip: Sunday treat that still fits the numbers.

recipes.name: Moong sprouts chaat
ingredients: 40 g whole green moong (sprouted, about 1 cup)
20 g onion, 30 g tomato, lemon, chaat masala, coriander
steps: Steam the sprouts 3 min, or eat raw.
Toss with everything else.
recipes.tip: Soak Saturday night; sprouts are ready by Monday.

recipes.name: Roasted chana + buttermilk
ingredients: Buttermilk: 75 g curd, 200 ml water, salt, roasted cumin
steps: Whisk the buttermilk.
Eat the chana with it.

recipes.name: Apple + Greek yogurt / hung curd
ingredients: 100 g Greek yogurt or hung curd
steps: Slice the apple and eat with the yogurt, cinnamon optional.
recipes.tip: Hang 400 g curd overnight to get about 200 g.

recipes.name: Kala chana chaat
ingredients: 40 g kala chana, soaked overnight and boiled
20 g onion, 30 g tomato, lemon, chaat masala
steps: Toss everything together.

recipes.name: 2 boiled eggs + cucumber
steps: Boil 9 min, peel and season.

recipes.name: Roasted makhana + buttermilk
ingredients: 2 g ghee or oil, salt, pepper
steps: Roast makhana in the ghee on low heat 5–6 min until crisp.
Season; serve with buttermilk.

recipes.name: Crispy okra fries + buttermilk
ingredients: 150 g okra (bhindi), ends trimmed, left whole
Pinch of salt, ½ tsp garam masala, chaat masala
steps: Boil the okra in salted water for 2 min and drain well.
Toss while warm with cornflour and garam masala.
Air-fry at 200 °C for 10 min, then toss 1–2 min in a pan with the oil spray.
Dust with chaat masala.
recipes.tip: Low in protein, so it rides with buttermilk as a snack or sits beside dal as a side.

recipes.name: Cabbage chicken dumplings (5 rolls)
ingredients: 5–6 cabbage leaves (about 150 g), from a boiled cabbage
50 g onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 green chilli, all finely chopped
5 g oil, salt, schezwan or green chutney to dip
steps: Boil the whole cabbage 10–15 min and peel off whole leaves.
Blend chicken, eggs and salt to a paste; mix in onion, garlic and chilli.
Spoon filling onto each leaf and roll into a sealed parcel.
Sear in the oiled pan on all sides, then cover and cook 8–10 min until the filling is firm.
recipes.tip: The reel's single serving. No rice: 61 g protein for 506 kcal. Keep the dip to 1 tbsp.

recipes.name: Malai chicken + rice + salad
ingredients: 150 g boneless chicken (half the reel's 300 g batch)
15 g curd, 5 g ginger-garlic paste, salt, pepper
35 g raw rice (100 g cooked) + 100 g cucumber salad
steps: Mix chicken with everything except rice and salad; rest 5 min in the fridge.
Air-fry at 195 °C for 15 min, pouring leftover marinade on top.
Serve with rice and salad.
recipes.tip: Make the full 300 g batch and eat the second half on Sunday.

recipes.name: Paneer tikka rice bowl
ingredients: 1 capsicum and 1 onion, cut into squares
50 g curd, 1 tsp coriander-cumin, 1 tsp chilli, garam masala, chaat masala, salt
steps: Coat paneer and vegetables in curd and spices.
Cook in the oiled pan, covered, 4–5 min.
Add the rice and toss until hot.
recipes.tip: The reel says 70 g protein. That needs about 350 g paneer; this 200 g portion gives 43 g.

recipes.name: Chilli garlic paneer fried rice
ingredients: Paste: 5 garlic cloves, 1½ tsp chilli, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp salt
5 g oil (the reel uses 10 g butter)
50 g onion, 150 g mixed veg (beans, carrot, corn, peas, capsicum)
50 g raw basmati (150 g cooked), coriander
steps: Pound the paste ingredients with a splash of water.
Fry paste and onion in oil 2 min, add paneer, then the vegetables.
Add rice and coriander; toss until coated.
recipes.tip: The reel's version is 530 kcal / 33 g protein. Less fat and rice brings it to 484 kcal.

recipes.name: Air-fryer chicken kabab + 2 chapatis + salad
ingredients: 150 g skinless chicken breast or thigh (the reel uses skin-on)
A little beaten egg (1 egg covers 500 g chicken)
1 tsp cornflour, 1–2 tsp chicken kabab masala
steps: Mix chicken with egg, cornflour and masala; rest 15 min.
Air-fry at 180 °C for 18–20 min, shaking once.
Serve with chapatis and salad.
recipes.tip: Skinless chicken saves about 150 kcal over the reel's skin-on pieces.

recipes.name: Green soya rice (hariyali / nati style) + curd
ingredients: 50 g soya chunks, soaked and squeezed
Green paste: 1 cup coriander, ½ cup mint, 3 green chillies, 5 garlic, ginger, 2 cloves, small cinnamon, ½ tsp cumin, ½ tsp fennel
50 g onion, 7 g oil, garam masala, salt
steps: Blend the paste with a little water.
Fry onion and soya in oil until golden (about 8 min).
Add paste and cook 3 min; add garam masala, salt, rice and 150 ml water.
Bring to a boil, cover and cook on low 15–20 min (or stir the masala into 180 g cooked rice, nati style).
recipes.tip: Combines both soya rice reels (hariyali and nati). The reels use 2–3 tbsp oil; 7 g keeps it at 563 kcal.

recipes.name: Korean-style crispy soya + stir-fried veg
ingredients: 60 g soya chunks, boiled with salt and ginger-garlic, drained
10 g rice flour, 10 g cornflour, ½ tsp chilli, 2 tsp soy sauce
Sauce: 5 g oil, 40 g onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp gochujang (or schezwan sauce), 1 tsp ketchup, chilli, splash of water
steps: Coat the drained soya in flours, chilli and soy sauce; air-fry until crisp.
Fry onion and garlic in oil, add gochujang, ketchup, chilli and water; simmer 1 min.
Toss the soya in the sauce 2–3 min; top with sesame and spring onion.
Serve with the stir-fried vegetables.
recipes.tip: Gochujang is in most supermarkets and online; schezwan sauce is a fine swap.

recipes.name: Egg ghee roast (light) + 1 chapati
ingredients: Masala: 6–8 soaked byadagi chillies, 5 garlic, 5 g cashews, 1 tbsp tamarind water
Roast and grind: 1 tbsp coriander seeds, 1 tsp cumin, ½ tsp pepper, pinch methi, cinnamon, 2 cloves, curry leaves
steps: Scramble the eggs and whites softly; set aside.
Dry-roast the whole spices and grind; add chillies, garlic, cashews and tamarind and grind to a paste.
Cook the paste in ghee with curry leaves until it thickens, adding water as needed.
Fold in the eggs, cover 1 min.
recipes.tip: Cutting the ghee from 4 tbsp to 1 tsp saves about 450 kcal. Grind a double batch of masala and freeze half.

recipes.name: High-protein paneer pasta
ingredients: Sauce: 200 g low-fat paneer, 3 garlic cloves, 2 dried red chillies, 100 ml double-toned milk, salt
steps: Cook pasta with onion, tomato, salt and just enough water until the water is absorbed.
Blend paneer, garlic, chillies, milk and salt smooth.
Stir the sauce into the pasta, cover on low 5 min.
Season with oregano and peri-peri.
recipes.tip: The reel's 62 g protein covers 1–2 servings; one serving here is 49 g.

recipes.name: Coriander butter garlic chicken + 1 chapati
ingredients: 1 tsp cornflour, pinch baking soda, salt, pepper, dash of soy sauce
Purée: 50 g low-fat paneer (soaked 15 min), big handful coriander, 1 green chilli
5 g butter + 2 g oil, 40 g onion, lots of garlic, ½ tsp garam masala, pinch sugar
steps: Marinate chicken 10–15 min.
Sear on high heat 3–4 min per side; set aside.
Melt butter, fry garlic and onion, add the purée and seasonings.
Return the chicken, toss, finish with lemon and chilli flakes.
recipes.tip: Reel stated 480 kcal / 58 g protein. The stock cube is optional; it is very salty.

recipes.name: Pre-workout: banana + black coffee
steps: Eat 30–45 min before training.
recipes.tip: Skip it on rest days, or if you train fasted.

recipes.name: Post-workout whey shake (1 scoop in 250 ml water)
steps: Shake and drink within an hour after training.
recipes.tip: Milk instead of water adds about 90 kcal per 200 ml.

recipes.name: Glass of buttermilk (masala majjiga/chaas)
steps: Whisk everything together.

prep: Portion the chicken into 150 g bags (ask for one portion minced in Week A). Fridge Mon–Wed, freeze the rest.
Week A: portion the fish into 3 × 150 g; freeze Friday and Sunday bags.
Pressure-cook 90 g toor dal and make 3 bowls of protein sambar.
Make an onion-tomato masala base for the week's curries. Keeps 5 days.
Wash and chop the mixed vegetables into 250 g bags.
Hang 400–600 g curd overnight in a cloth for Greek-style curd.
Soak green moong on Saturday night for Monday's sprouts; soak more the night before each pesarattu day.
Week B: grind the egg ghee roast masala and freeze half.
Marinate tandoori chicken the night before Friday.

adjustments.how: Add 1 chapati to dinner (120) or 100 g cooked rice (130).
Add a glass of buttermilk and 15 g roasted chana.
Skip the pre-workout banana, or halve the snack.
Swap dinner rice for extra vegetables (−130) and use 3 g oil instead of 5 g.
